label: Dairy & Eggs

passages.title: Wholesome Morning Nutrition: The Everyday Versatility of Dairy and Eggs
passages.titleVi: Dinh dưỡng buổi sáng lành mạnh: Sự đa dạng bổ dưỡng của sản phẩm từ sữa và trứng
passages.text: Starting the day with wholesome nutritious foods gives our minds and bodies sustained energy for work, study, and physical exercise. Around the world, classic morning meals frequently feature fresh dairy foods and high-quality farm eggs that supply vital amino acids. Cracking a fresh organic egg into a heated nonstick skillet with a small pat of creamy butter creates a delicious foundation for breakfast. Many home cooks prefer gently whisking two eggs together before cooking them into fluffy scrambled eggs, seasoned lightly with black pepper and herbs. Adding a generous sprinkle of grated cheddar cheese melts smoothly over the top, enhancing both rich flavor and total protein content. In the refrigerator, a fresh carton of cold milk provides essential calcium, which strengthens teeth and bones across every stage of human life. Pouring milk over whole-grain oats creates a soothing milky porridge, or you can whisk it into coffee for a comforting beverage. Meanwhile, thick Greek yogurt topped with honey, crunchy walnuts, and seasonal berries delivers beneficial probiotics that assist healthy digestion. Some bakers even whip a small spoonful of heavy cream into omelet mixtures, creating an airy texture that delights weekend brunch guests. Furthermore, modern supermarkets offer diverse options alongside traditional choices, ensuring that individuals with lactose sensitivities can also enjoy nourishing breakfasts. Because these versatile staples blend effortlessly into sweet or savory recipes, busy households rely on them daily. Nutritionists consistently remind us that taking time for a balanced breakfast significantly enhances daytime focus and stabilizes blood sugar. Ultimately, combining farm-fresh eggs with wholesome cultured dairy products allows families to create balanced morning plates that satisfy taste buds while promoting long-term physical wellness and vitality.

pronunciationNotesVi: Từ 'scrambled' /ˈskræm.bəld/ có cụm phụ âm /skr/ ở đầu và đuôi kết thúc bằng phụ âm bật /ld/ hữu thanh.
Từ 'dairy' /ˈdɛr.i/ có nguyên âm đôi /ɛr/ chuẩn giọng Mỹ, khác với 'daily' /ˈdeɪ.li/ mang âm phụ âm /l/.
Từ 'protein' /ˈproʊ.tin/ có trọng âm rơi vào âm tiết đầu tiên với âm đôi /oʊ/, âm tiết sau phát âm rõ /tin/.
Trong cụm 'carton of milk', phụ âm /n/ của 'carton' nối tự nhiên sang giới từ /əv/ tạo nhịp điệu trôi chảy.

They take several hours of preparation before they can be eaten safely

comprehensionQuestions.explanationVi: Đoạn văn nêu rõ trứng và các sản phẩm từ sữa là lựa chọn kinh điển vì cung cấp các axit amin thiết yếu, năng lượng bền bỉ và canxi củng cố xương răng.

passages.title: The Farmhouse Creamery: Traditional Dairy Craft and Fresh Morning Eggs
passages.titleVi: Xưởng làm bơ sữa gia đình: Nghề làm sữa truyền thống và trứng tươi buổi sáng
passages.text:
Early each morning at Sunrise Valley Creamery, farmer Thomas opens the creaking barn door as the brass hinge swings smoothly. Outside, there is a brisk autumn nip in the misty dawn air. Thomas first visits the chicken coops to gather warm, brown eggs laid by healthy free-range hens. He places each clean egg patiently into woven straw baskets, ensuring none are cracked. These farm-fresh eggs provide high-quality protein and essential vitamins that offer preventive nutritional benefits for growing children.

Inside the nearby dairy facility, fresh morning cow milk is transferred into large mirrored stainless steel cooling tanks. Thomas uses modern scientific testing to maintain uncompromising sanitary standards. Using an optical laboratory microscope, trained technicians examine milk samples to ensure that only beneficial microbial cultures are present. When preparing artisanal farmhouse yogurt, they warm the milk gently so helpful probiotic bacteria can multiply safely, giving the creamy yogurt its rich, velvety texture.

In the climate-controlled aging room, wheels of cheddar and gouda cheese rest on cedar shelves for several months. With time and unwavering persistence, the cheese develops a remarkably mellow, nutty flavor that delights food lovers. Acclaimed chefs from posh urban restaurants drive out to the countryside every weekend to purchase Thomas award-winning butter, cheeses, and eggs. They often serve soft-boiled eggs over steamed napa cabbage and warm buttered sourdough toast.

Thomas takes immense pride in his traditional farming methods. By honoring animal welfare and meticulous hygiene, his small family business demonstrates that wholesome dairy and farm-fresh eggs remain the nutritious foundation of everyday culinary enjoyment.

pronunciationNotesVi: mellow (/ˈmel.oʊ/): Âm tiết đầu nhấn trọng âm mạnh mẽ "mel", âm tiết thứ hai kết thúc bằng nguyên âm đôi /oʊ/ nhẹ và êm tai.
microbial (/maɪˈkroʊ.bi.əl/): Trọng âm chính rơi vào âm tiết thứ hai "cro" /kroʊ/, âm đầu là /maɪ/ rõ ràng với nguyên âm đôi.
microscope (/ˈmaɪ.krə.skoʊp/): Trọng âm chính rơi vào âm tiết đầu "mi" /maɪ/, âm tiết cuối kết thúc bằng âm bật môi /p/ dứt khoát.
preventive (/prɪˈven.t̬ɪv/): Trọng âm chính rơi vào âm tiết thứ hai "ven", tiền tố "pre-" đọc lướt là /prɪ/, đuôi "-tive" đọc là /t̬ɪv/.

comprehensionQuestions.question: Why do technicians examine milk samples under an optical laboratory microscope?
options: To ensure high sanitary standards and verify that only beneficial microbial cultures are present
To measure the exact electrical conductance of raw milk in units of siemens
To count the number of unfertilized eggs gathered from the chicken coops
To photograph the mirrored stainless steel cooling tanks for tourist pamphlets
comprehensionQuestions.explanationVi: Đoạn văn nêu rõ các kỹ thuật viên dùng kính hiển vi quang học kiểm tra mẫu sữa để đảm bảo các tiêu chuẩn vệ sinh cao và xác minh chỉ có các chủng vi sinh có lợi (beneficial microbial cultures) tồn tại.

comprehensionQuestions.question: What gives the farmhouse aged cheese its remarkably mellow, nutty flavor?
options: Resting on cedar shelves in an aging room for several months through unwavering persistence
Adding synthetic chemical food dyes and artificial flavor powders before packaging
Boiling the milk with shredded napa cabbage in an iron cauldron over high heat
Transporting the curd immediately to posh urban restaurants on the same morning
comprehensionQuestions.explanationVi: Đoạn văn giải thích rằng các bánh phô mai nằm nghỉ trên kệ gỗ tuyết tùng trong phòng ủ suốt nhiều tháng (resting on cedar shelves for several months), phát triển hương vị đằm thắm (mellow) nhờ thời gian và sự kiên trì.

comprehensionQuestions.question: How does farmer Thomas handle the freshly gathered morning eggs?
options: He places each clean egg patiently into woven straw baskets, ensuring none are cracked
He washes them immediately in boiling water and stores them in metal irons
He discards all brown eggs and only sells white eggs to city restaurant chefs
He freezes them in mirrored cooling tanks to prevent bacteria from multiplying
comprehensionQuestions.explanationVi: Đoạn văn nêu rõ bác Thomas kiên nhẫn xếp từng quả trứng sạch sẽ vào giỏ rơm đan (places each clean egg patiently into woven straw baskets) để đảm bảo không có quả nào bị nứt.
